description: Tight SAT — D=7, P=4, K=4. Low cadence (sum=8), tight pillar_min (sum=4 vs sum_cadence=8), aggressive diversity (min_gap=4 everywhere). Solver finds the narrow feasible region.
_optimum_note: Empirically confirmed on 2026-05-20: solver returns objective=37 (e.g. 4*pillar_1 + 2*pillar_2 + 1*pillar_3 + 1*pillar_4 = 24+8+3+2=37). Tight because sum(pillar_min)=4 and sum(cadence)=8 — half the slots must spread across all four pillars; min_gap=4 across D=7 limits each pillar to 2 appearances per platform.
_diversity_bounds: min_gap=4 across D=7 means each pillar can appear at most 2 times per platform (days 1 and 5, or 2 and 6, etc.). With 4 platforms × 2 max-per-platform = 8 max appearances per pillar globally, but pillar_max caps tighter.
